control.name: BETTER_AUTH_BASE_URL
control.purpose: Canonical HTTPS origin used by Better Auth.

control.name: BETTER_AUTH_TRUSTED_ORIGINS
control.purpose: Comma-separated exact origins allowed to make credentialed control-plane requests.

control.name: CONTROL_BASE_DOMAIN
control.purpose: Hostname of the control Worker, without a scheme or path.

control.name: PUBLIC_BASE_DOMAIN
control.purpose: Base hostname used to construct and validate published-site hosts.

control.name: PUBLIC_CONTENT_DOMAIN
control.purpose: Public-content hostname suffix used to construct canonical project URLs.

control.name: R2_ACCOUNT_ID
control.purpose: Cloudflare account identifier used by the R2 S3 signing endpoint.

control.name: R2_BUCKET_NAME
control.purpose: R2 bucket name embedded in presigned upload URLs.

control.name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
control.purpose: High-entropy key used by Better Auth to protect sessions and tokens.

control.name: SIGNUP_ALLOWED_EMAILS
control.purpose: Private comma-separated allowlist of accounts permitted to sign up.

control.name: R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID
control.purpose: Access key for the bucket-scoped R2 API token used to sign uploads.

control.name: R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
control.purpose: Secret key for the bucket-scoped R2 API token used to sign uploads.

public.name: PUBLIC_BASE_DOMAIN
public.purpose: Base hostname against which incoming published-site hosts are validated.
